facts.activity_file: handing back a partially completed isolation

control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task
controlled removal of isolation and return to service
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: residual pressure found after isolation of ML-3201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the identification of every energy source for the task on ML-3201 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. ML-3201 (grinding mills) is in service for two-line ball milling. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 19 December 2004 a near hit was recorded on ML-3201 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
